verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an analytics SaaS with Events and Stats APIs, but the evidence never documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Self-hosting Community Edition or team-scoped API keys would only be user-side workarounds or adjacent controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
